findings: Owner request 2026-11-09: practice long questions for Chapter 7 in the same format as the Physics chapter practice, long questions in the Biology Board shape (4 marks each) (English and Roman Urdu), written from the chapter; not printed in the book. 9 questions numbered 1-9; by section: 7.1 2, 7.2 1, 7.3 3, 7.4 3.

The chapter is short, so the set is small. Covers active sites and domains, the coronavirus case (drug target and host-pathogen interaction), protein crystallization and the diffraction steps, the areas and applications of computational biology, BLAST and FASTA, orthologs and paralogs, the significance of sequence homology, and structural homology. Angles differ from the exercise long questions (applications as a whole, principle and working of X-ray crystallography, key databases).
Every question carries a book_ref (topic id and exact words of that topic's English lesson), verified by tools.py.
The Roman Urdu file has the same checkpoints, order and book_refs; each prompt keeps the English question with the Roman Urdu meaning in brackets.
Drafts for the academic review (second-person review before publication).
